pull.title: scripted-diff: Drop `IWYU pragma: keep` from build config includes
pull.body:
This PR marks the `bitcoin-build-config.h` header with the dedicated [`IWYU pragma: always_keep`](https://github.com/include-what-you-use/include-what-you-use/blob/master/docs/IWYUPragmas.md#iwyu-pragma-always_keep), which makes the per-include `IWYU pragma: keep` comments redundant.

As a result, grepping for `IWYU pragma: keep` returns only the genuine use cases, each of which should be properly documented.

Verified the scripted diff and reviewed the patch manually and confirmed locally that the updated lint catches these reintroductions.

Note that other open PRs add or move the old annotation and may cause silent merge conflicts (#36743, #36628, #36608, #36434, #35368, #32966, #30988, #30437, #19461, #19460, #10102).

Small non-blocking nit: We don’t usually script a one-off documentation edits, so I’d find the removal of “Make sure to include it with the IWYU pragma” easier to review as a manual change - but I do appreciate having the repetitive replacements done as a scripted diff.

> may cause silent merge conflicts

Most of them need rebase already. For those that don't, none of them have any review, but it could make sense to re-run the lint task or leave a comment after this is merged?

scripted-diff: Drop `IWYU pragma: keep` from build config includes

The `bitcoin-build-config.h` header is now marked with
`IWYU pragma: always_keep`, which makes the per-include
`IWYU pragma: keep` comments redundant.

-BEGIN VERIFY SCRIPT-
OLD='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h> // IWYU pragma: keep'
NEW='#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>'
sed -i "s|$OLD|$NEW|" $(git grep -l "$OLD")

GUARD='#ifndef BITCOIN_CONFIG_H'
PRAGMA='// IWYU pragma: always_keep'
sed -i "s|^$GUARD$|$PRAGMA\n\n&|" cmake/bitcoin-build-config.h.in
-END VERIFY SCRIPT-

comments.body:
This comment is now outdated.

```diff
- "#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>" // Catch redundant includes with and without the IWYU pragma
+ "#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>"
```

The whole `mode` branch can be removed here? Maybe the linter change can be done in a separate commit wholesale, as mentioned by https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36875#pullrequestreview-5916379834

(No one is bisecting the linters, so them failing shouldn't matter at all.)

Now is without mode. I was going to suggest that but didn't because thought it might be out of scope.

The `mode==true` branch gets all files that include some macros from `bitcoin-build-config.h` and insists that all those files contain `^#include <bitcoin-build-config.h>$`. But if some file contains ` #include <bitcoin-build-config.h>` (with leading space) it would be reported as "This file uses some macros but does not include `bitcoin-build-config.h`" (which would be wrong).

Now is better. I guess things like `/* inside comment #include <bitcoin-build-config.h> hoho */` are not supported ;-)
